decisions.reason: Relocating the battery connector to the back of the Power Board does not change the established three-board architecture.
The source changes the connector's physical placement but does not change the requirement for an NTC contact on the battery connector.
The physical relocation of the battery connector does not alter the specified overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection behavior.
Battery connector placement does not affect charge-status indication through the main-board SK6812 LED chain.
The source specifies a mechanical connector location and does not modify the Power Board's TVS ESD protection.
Battery connector placement is unrelated to I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
Moving the battery connector does not change ESP32 clocking, sleep policy, deep-sleep conditions, or wake sources.
The battery connector's physical location does not alter the software-switched 5V rail, its enable circuitry, or its operating pattern.
